messages.author: 6a97b0f956f02af4
messages.subject: Shiny app with encoding problems
parts:
Hi,

I have three files: ui.R, server.R, and utils.R, where in utils.R I define a vector of Danish municipality names. Here a few municipality names: Navn <- c('Alle','Aabenraa','Aalborg','Aarhus','Albertslund','Allerød','Assens')
The vector is used to populate a selectInput widget. Even though all three files are saved with encoding 'UTF-8' in RStudio... when running the app, names like 'Allerød' are not shown correct.
However, when creating the choices for another selectInput directly within the definition of the widget in the ui.R file e.g. choices = c('årligt', 'månedlige', 'ugentlig'), then this is correctly shown in the app.

utils.R is referenced in the ui.R file with source('utils.R'). Any other things I have to consider when using the utils.R file, or any other R file in conjunction with my app to get the correct encoding shown?
The list of municipality names will simply clutter my ui file, hence it was'out-sourced'.


I am running Windows 10 with

R in version: 3.4.1 (2017-06-30)
Shiny in version: 1.0.3
Shinydashboard in version: 0.6.1

Thanks Thomas

messages.author: 6ca62a5f409b469f
messages.subject: Re: Shiny app with encoding problems
parts:
Hi Thomas,
It's probably the `source` call that's giving you trouble.

Here's something you can try:

source('utils.R', encoding = "UTF-8")

If that doesn't work, this might be helpful: https://stackoverflow.com/a/5588488

Alan
